profile.headline: Staff Software Engineer at CommonLit
profile.summary: I’m a full stack software engineer with over a decade of experience working at startups and growing organizations. I enjoy working across the stack, from designing data models to perfecting UIs, as well as mentoring other engineers. Some of my areas of focus include relational database performance and automated testing strategies.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.insights: Ruby, Ruby on Rails and +2 skills

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked as a full stack software engineer and tech lead for the Extensibility and Integrations team at ActBlue. ActBlue processes millions of small dollar donations to Democrats each year, working with everyone from presidential campaigns to city council candidates. As a Staff Engineer, I provided technical leadership both within my team and across the engineering organization.
positions.insights: Amazon Web Services (AWS), RSpec and +5 skills

positions.title: Senior Fullstack Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked on the Member Experience team, building tools to help provide Devoted members with the best experience and care, and to support the Guide (customer service) team.

positions.title: Tech Lead, Site Engagement
positions.description: I led a team within BookBub's software engineering organization focused on site engagement--improving the user experience of the BookBub.com consumer web site to drive engagement, page views and ad impressions. I collaborated with Product and other stakeholders, mentored other engineers, and contributed code directly to projects we worked on.
positions.insights: Elasticsearch, Amazon Web Services (AWS) and +6 skills

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
I implemented a variety of full stack projects with Ruby on Rails and React including:
 - a targeted, auction based ad platform to serve ads from authors and publishers in millions of daily emails
 - a billing microservice for BookBub’s ad products
 - Site and email-based features for receiving updates on new releases and preorders.
 - improvements to BookBub’s Elasticsearch-based book and author search.
I also participated in the infrastructure on-call rotation, handling urgent issues across all web applications on nights and weekends.

positions.title: Account Coordinator
positions.description: Worked with independent author partners and small publishers to coordinate BookBub promotions. Beginning in January 2015, spent 50% of time working with Engineering to build internal tools using Ruby and Ruby on Rails.
